_about: Engagement and wedding (dungeon/life/wedding.py). `customs`: how a wedding goes by the city's calendar (dungeon/world/catalog.calendar_id) or else its era group (dungeon/life/admin.era_group): the words, the order of the day, venue words and place kinds (`else`: the kinds when the city has none of those, for a church wedding in a town without a church), the church's closed seasons the old eras keep (`closed`: advent, advent-epiphany, lent or septuagesima, dungeon/life/wedding.SEASONS), the weekday (0 Monday) and hours, months engaged and guests by size, the budget in months of the companion's take-home by size and the share they pay, the ring (months of take-home, and one ring per pay tier), how one asks, what they wear by pronoun, and the planning on the Life admin calendar (`after` days from the engagement, or `before` days before the wedding). `invite`: the first text inviting the user out on the evening they will propose, when no model writes it ({place}, {day}, {time}; it never gives the proposal away). `engaged`: their feed post the day they get engaged. `married`: the caption on the wedding photo. At least 100 each; gender-neutral and era-neutral.
